greeting: Need storage? I got barrels for every occasion!
You look like someone with things to hide. I mean, STORE!
Barrelman Bob's the name, containment's my game!
Fresh barrels just rolled in! Well, I rolled them. They're heavy.
Back again? You know what they say - once you go barrel, you never go... uh... back to... regular storage!
Sun's high, barrels are rolling! That's a Bob guarantee!
If it fits, it sits! In a barrel, I mean. Not me. That was one time.
dialog.shop_open: What size you need? Small, medium, or 'hide-a-body' large? ...Kidding! That one's called 'extra large'.
dialog.shop_prompt: Barrels for sale! Oak, pine, or my specialty - reclaimed from who-knows-where!
haggle: These prices are already scraping the barrel! Get it? Scraping?
Tell you what - buy two, I'll throw in a lid. Can't use a barrel without a lid!
For you? Special price. For everyone else? Also special price. I'm very generous.
I'd go lower, but my brother in the Obsidian Reach would kill me. Family pricing standards, you know?
purchase_success: Pleasure doing business! Need rope to tie it down?
That one's waterproof, fireproof, and mostly gnaw-proof!
She's a beaut! Treat her right and she'll hold your secrets - I mean, supplies! - for years.
Sold! Tell your friends! Tell strangers! Tell that metal barrel guy down the street I'm better!
purchase_fail: Money's tight, huh? Come back when the barrels are flowing!
Can't do credit. Learned that lesson the hard way. Don't ask.
Hey, no judgment. Times are tough. Come back when you strike it rich!
rumor: Heard there's a barrel in the Mire that walks around at night. My cousin swears it!
Word is Deep-Dig Dan found something BIG in the tunnels. Won't say what. Suspicious, right?
That luchador El Scorcho? Used to be a barrel wrestler. True story. Don't ask which promotion.
Metal Barrel Mike claims his barrels are 'superior.' Ha! Metal rusts. Wood has character!
dialog.quest_hook: Say, you look like adventurous types. Lost a shipment of premium barrels in the Scorched Wastes. Bandits, probably. Or giant scorpions. Hard to tell with barrels. Find 'em and I'll make it worth your while!
dialog.quest_active: Any luck finding my barrels? Last I saw, they were rolling toward certain doom. Or the Mire. Same thing, really.
dialog.quest_complete: My barrels! My beautiful barrels! You found them! Here, take this. And a barrel. Everyone needs a barrel!
dialog.quest_reward: Premium Barrel Coupon - 50% off your next containment solution!
farewell: Roll on back anytime! ...Barrel joke. Sorry.
Don't let the desert get ya! Or do. More barrel customers for me!
Keep 'em rolling! I'm contractually obligated to say that.
ambient_barks: Round and sturdy! Like my grandmother!
Can't have too many barrels! Well, you can. I have a warehouse.
Need to store something? I don't judge!
Metal barrels are for amateurs! Wood breathes!
If my barrels could talk... actually, I'm glad they can't.
dialog.time_dawn: Early bird gets the barrel! Or worm. Worms don't buy barrels.
dialog.time_noon: Hot one today! Good thing barrels don't sweat. Unlike me.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening shoppers get evening prices! ...Same as day prices, but sounds special, right?
dialog.time_night: Late night barrel emergency? I don't judge. I've been there.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The barrel rescuer returns! Welcome, hero of containers!
barrel_pun: This business has its ups and downs! Round and round, really.

party_reactions.nix7: Illogical inventory. Barrels serve single purpose. Overstock inefficient.
party_reactions.twist: Can I hide in a barrel? Like in the stories?
party_reactions.renna: Do you have anything... not barrel-related? No?

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face! First barrel's at full price. That's how friendship works!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more? Knew you were a barrel connoisseur!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! Got some premium oak in the back, just for you.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Listen, between us? I got a barrel that fell off a cart. Slightly used. Very slightly. Interested?

mini_quest.title: Lost Shipment
mini_quest.description: Find Bob's missing barrels in the Scorched Wastes

stages.hook: Lost a shipment of premium barrels in the Scorched Wastes. Bandits, probably. Or giant scorpions. Hard to tell with barrels.
stages.active: Three barrels, marked with my logo - a barrel, naturally. Last seen heading toward scorpion territory. Brave barrels.
stages.complete: You magnificent barrel-finders! My inventory is whole again! Here - take this compass. Points toward the nearest barrel. Don't ask how it works.
